title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in WPDeveloper…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WPDeveloper NotificationX plugin versions up to 3.3.6. This flaw involves improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, allowing an attacker to inject code. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.3. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
